_comment: Tone for ALL occasion posts: brief, dignified, no sales pitch — two or three sentences, one clean design card. Selling on an occasion post undoes the point of posting. See docs/AlDurrSocialSystemv2.md §4.

lunar._comment: Lunar dates shift ~11 days earlier annually. Fill in each year's actual Gregorian date against a current Iraqi calendar BEFORE batching — never carry last year's dates forward. Empty 'dates' means unconfirmed; the strategist will flag these as needing confirmation rather than guess.
